_comment: Klub českých turistů (KČT, the Czech Tourist Club): the public hikes, ski and cycle tours its local branches list on kct.cz/kalendar-akci. kct.cz publishes no feed and no schema.org Event, so mapsee_ingest_kct.py reads the calendar page once (every event, as an inline FullCalendar JSON array) and then each in-window event's page (the start and finish, the routes, the organiser and a map pin the page explains). robots.txt on kct.cz is empty (HTTP 200, 0 bytes: RFC 9309 says no rules); the site links no terms of use, and /gdpr/ is the membership consent form. Read the adapter's header before changing a rule.
_found: manual:2026-10-24 Czechia had 9 curated community sources and 0 outdoors; kct.cz/kalendar-akci is the national club's calendar of public hikes
_measured: 2026-10-24: 3,999 events listed, 1,056 to come, 241 within 90 days (4 of them club meetings). All 237 other event pages read (12.3 min over two runs, ~3 s a page): 155 pinned at the organiser's start, 58 at the finish (star hikes), 24 at the centre-of-Czechia placeholder. Of the 213 organiser pins 193 are written (81% of the pages, 80% of the window): 13 name no district to check, 3 lie over 50 km from theirs (two one-degree slips), 2 outside Czechia, 2 have two decimals. The written pins sit a median 11.0 km from their district's point (p90 26.8, max 47.0). A start clock is shown on 63 pages.
_within_days: Event pages are read only for events starting within this many days (237 on 2026-10-24).
_run_weekdays: Wednesday and Sunday (0 = Monday), as AVA: a club's hike is listed weeks ahead and rarely changes, and each event page is ~380 KB from a volunteer club's server. Wednesday is the feeds job's refresh day, so a changed start reaches the stored row.
_refresh_days: The cursor re-reads an unchanged event's page after this many days; reread_within_days re-reads every run for events starting that soon.
_district_radius_km: A pin must lie within this distance of the Wikidata point of a district the event names. On 2026-10-24 the 193 written pins sat a median 11.0 km from theirs (max 47.0, Kralicky Sneznik's summit 41.5); the two one-degree slips were 109 and 111 km out. Districts reach about 40 km from their town (Sedlec-Prcice from Pribram, Kasejovice from Plzen for Plzen-jih).
_districts: The 76 okresy and Prague, keyed by kct.cz's own okres-<slug> post class: Wikidata P625 of every item with P31 Q548611 (district of the Czech Republic) and no P576, plus Q1085 (Praha), read 2026-10-24. Most points are the district town (Plzen-jih, Plzen-sever and Brno-venkov share their city's).
_district_aliases: Free-text districts the list carries that are not a district's name: Decinsko, HK, and the three statutory cities written without '-mesto'.

_not_included.what: Events whose page pins the centre of Czechia (49.743756, 15.3360752)
_not_included.why: The page says so: no coordinates, start place or district were entered. 24 of 237 pages within 90 days on 2026-10-24, some with a street address in the text; Photon is not a geocoder this repo trusts without an expected area (geocoding-and-addresses.md).

_not_included.what: Club conferences, programme councils, leaders' training and exams
_not_included.why: On the same calendar, not public outings (4 of 241 within 90 days on 2026-10-24).

_not_included.what: The contact person's phone and email on every page
